questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Regular exercise keeps the body fit. It also improves mood and sleep. Therefore, doctors advise that everyone should ___
options: make exercise a part of daily life.
questions.explanation: Therefore signals a recommendation that follows from the benefits.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Water is essential for life. Without it, plants wither and animals die. So, we should ___
options: conserve water and avoid wasting it.
questions.explanation: The paragraph shows the importance of water, so we should conserve it.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
The library was silent. Students were bent over their books. Suddenly ___
options: rain is a form of water.
questions.explanation: Suddenly signals an event that interrupts the silence.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Ravi wanted to become a doctor. He studied hard for years. Finally, ___
options: he got admission to a medical college.
questions.explanation: The story continues with the reward of his effort.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Plastic bags take hundreds of years to decay. They also harm animals that eat them. Many cities have therefore ___
questions.explanation: Therefore signals a response to the harm.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
The train was late by two hours. Passengers were tired and angry. The station master ___
options: apologised and announced the new time.
questions.explanation: A natural response to the delay is an apology and update.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Social media connects people across the world. However, it also ___
options: was invented in the stone age.
questions.explanation: However introduces a downside.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
A good leader listens before he decides. He values the opinions of his team. As a result, ___
options: the team trusts and respects him.
questions.explanation: As a result signals a positive consequence.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Many students think that cramming is the best way to study. Research shows, however, that ___
options: understanding concepts leads to better long-term learning.
questions.explanation: However introduces a contrast.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
India has a vast variety of languages. Each region has its own culture. This diversity ___
options: is found only in one state.
makes the country rich and colourful.
questions.explanation: The ending states the effect of the diversity.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Electric cars produce no smoke. They are also quiet. Yet many people hesitate to buy them because ___
options: they are costly and charging points are few.
questions.explanation: Yet signals a reason against buying them.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
The farmer sowed the seeds in June. The monsoon arrived on time. In October, ___
options: the seeds were still in the bag.
he sold his tractor in winter.
questions.explanation: The story ends with the harvest.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Sleep is not a waste of time. During sleep, the brain stores memories and the body repairs itself. Hence, ___
options: a good night's sleep is necessary for health.
questions.explanation: Hence signals a conclusion.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
She was nervous before the interview. She practised answers in front of the mirror. On the day, ___
questions.explanation: Her preparation led to confidence.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Critics argued that the new tax would hurt the poor. The government, however, ___
options: claimed that the money would be used for welfare schemes.
questions.explanation: However signals the government's contrasting view.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Early humans lived in caves and hunted for food. Over time, they learned to grow crops. This change, known as the agricultural revolution, ___
options: allowed people to settle in one place and form villages.
questions.explanation: The ending explains the effect of farming.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Although the film had a brilliant story, ___
options: it was a great film in every way.
its poor editing disappointed many viewers.
it was released in a theatre.
questions.explanation: Although introduces a contrasting weakness.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
The company promised to deliver the order in a week. Three weeks later, there was still no sign of it. Not surprisingly, ___
options: the week was extended to a year.
questions.explanation: The delay naturally leads to a demand for a refund.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Technology has made our lives easier in many ways. Yet there are costs: ___
options: people spend less time talking face to face.
questions.explanation: Yet costs signals a downside.

questions.question:
Choose the option that best completes the paragraph.
Because the bridge was unsafe, ___
options: the authorities opened it to heavier traffic.
the authorities closed it to traffic.
questions.explanation: The logical result of an unsafe bridge is closure.
